scripts.build: pnpm run build:assets && pnpm run deploy:dry-run:prod && pnpm run deploy:dry-run:dev
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm run build:assets && wrangler deploy --env prod
scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm run build:assets && wrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env dev --local
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env prod --remote
scripts.db:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env dev --remote
